## Pull request overview

Fixes TypeScript TS2742 declaration emit failures in `@object-ui/components` caused by non-portable inferred types from transitive dependencies (via `vaul` → `@radix-ui/react-dialog`), so downstream packages can import `Drawer`/`SidebarSeparator` without the d.ts build being skipped.

**Changes:**
- Update `drawer.tsx` to use concrete DOM element types in `forwardRef` generics and add explicit annotations for `DrawerTrigger`/`DrawerClose`.
- Update `sidebar.tsx` to use concrete DOM element types for `SidebarSeparator` instead of `typeof Separator`-based inference.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/components/src/ui/drawer.tsx | Replaces `typeof DrawerPrimitive.*`-derived ref/props typing with concrete DOM element types to avoid TS2742 during declaration generation. |
| packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx | Replaces `Separator`-derived ref/props typing with concrete DOM element typing to keep emitted types portable. |

This change modifies a component under `packages/components/src/ui/**`, which is maintained via the shadcn sync scripts and may be overwritten by future updates. To avoid losing the TS2742 fix, implement this type workaround in a wrapper under `packages/components/src/custom/` (and re-export it), or ensure the sync pipeline re-applies the patch when updating shadcn components.

These files live under `packages/components/src/ui/**` which is managed by the shadcn sync workflow; repo guidance marks this directory as a no-touch zone because changes can be overwritten by `pnpm shadcn:update`. To make this TS2742 fix durable, move the modified typings into a wrapper component under `packages/components/src/custom/` (and re-export from the package entry), or update the shadcn sync process so it re-applies this patch after updates.

Typing `DrawerTrigger` as `React.FC<...>` drops the original component’s `ref` support (React.FC doesn’t model the `ref` prop), which is a public type regression for consumers. Prefer keeping it as a `forwardRef` wrapper with a concrete element ref type (e.g. `HTMLButtonElement`) so `ref` continues to work while still avoiding TS2742.

`DrawerOverlay`/`DrawerContent` props were narrowed to plain `div` props. Vaul/Radix overlay/content components typically support additional behavior props (e.g. `forceMount`, focus/escape/outside-interaction handlers). Narrowing here can break downstream TypeScript users even if runtime still works. Consider defining local prop types that include the non-DOM props you intend to support (without referencing transitive `@radix-ui/*` types) so the wrapper API remains compatible.
